messages.subject: estimating CI for model avg D estimates
parts:
Hello all,
Thank you all for your help with my last inquiries. I am now trying to
derive a model averaged CI for my D estimates. In Distance, is the number of
encounters analogous to Mt+1, and if so, do you use the same process to
derive the model averaged CI??

Cheers,

e intervals, and select multiple models in the detection function tab of mo=
del definition, you will get a model-averaged confidence interval.
